description:
Designed with the lowest possible step-thru height the Simple Step-Thru bicycle makes riding easier and safer. Coupled with the low-step thru the frame geometry also features a forward pedal design. The pedals are positioned approximately four inches forward from where they are located on a traditional bike frame. This gives you the ability to keep your seat low to the ground while pedaling and still get great leg extension. It also makes stopping and dismounting much safer. You will be lower to the ground making it simple to get your feet planted firmly when stopping. Dismounting is a breeze, no more need to swing your leg over an unnecessarily high top tube thus virtually eliminating the risk of falling or tipping over. Added safety features doesn’t mean reduced performance. Featuring a 7 Speed Shimano Derailleur the Simple Step-Thru is capable of handling moderate hills, mid to long range rides, pavement or hard packed trails. The seven speeds will give you enough variance to tackle hills and also hit top speeds up to 16 miles per hour on flat ground. The 1.95” tires will roll smooth on pavement and also hard packed trails. The thicker tire size adds stability, again adding to the safety features while they also absorb more of the bumps and shocks on rides so your body doesn’t. Lastly, the riding position will situate you in an ergonomic position, relieving pressure on your wrists, shoulders, back and knees. You will complete your rides with less pain and soreness, so you can accomplish your normal daily activities as usual. And with the simple setup to dismount, you’ll know you have enough energy to dismount at the end of any ride. Safe, comfortable and it performs the Simple Step-Thru Hybrid Comfort bike. It’s not a question of if you’ll ride but how many miles.
